title: The Crossover Ashoka®
subtitle: Two-row Ashoka diamond ring — 18K yellow or white gold

stone.origin: Natural. Upper row set east-west, lower row north-south on a waved band. [NOTE: exact carat weights not available — confirm before going live.]

description: The Crossover Ashoka® by Bez Ambar — a two-row ring intentionally designed as one piece rather than two stackable bands. The upper row of elongated Ashoka-style step-cuts runs east-west; the lower row runs north-south on a waved shank, creating a perpetual crossover at the center. Available in 18-karat yellow gold or white gold. Ref BA-CR-001. [NOTE: stone carat weights need confirmation before going live.]
